Kerbside 0.7.11

Validate identity-first BODS GTFS-RT matching alongside the existing SIRI-VM fallback.

Release goals:
- use BODS matched GTFS-RT trip_id as first-class timetable identity when the physical vehicle, timestamp and position agree
- retain the existing SIRI journey/origin-time/geometry matcher when matched identity is unavailable or ambiguous
- keep confirmed matched identity sticky across short auxiliary-feed gaps, but expire it after three minutes
- do not let a stale SIRI destination override an exact matched GTFS trip during a terminus handover
- proxy and decode GTFS-RT server-side so the BODS API key stays in the Worker
- bump Kerbside to 0.7.11

Rerun note: update the browser regression source assertion for the expanded matched-identity test API.
